visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with her hair in a low ponytail, wearing a tan tank top and a white layered skirt. She is seated on a decorative patterned bench, playing a large brown wooden grand piano in a bright, white-walled room with horizontal tile details. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's face, capturing her intent and focused expression as she looks towards the piano keys; her earrings and a small hair clip are visible. (3) The camera transitions to a close-up of her hands, showing her fingers pressing the piano keys with precision, while the open lid of the grand piano is seen in the background. (4) The screen splits into a horizontal layout: the top portion shows the live performance, and the bottom half features a digital piano keyboard interface that visualizes the notes as they are played. (5) Several quick cuts follow, alternating between a top-down view of the digital keyboard, side angles of her playing, and close-ups of her facial expressions to emphasize the musical dynamics. (6) In the middle section, white Traditional Chinese subtitles appear at the bottom left, overlaid on the split-screen view. (7) Cinematic clips from a romantic drama featuring a man and a woman in a snowy night setting are inserted into the top frame, while the pianist remains visible in a semi-transparent overlay. (8) The performance concludes with the woman finishing the piece and resting her hands on the keys, followed by a final hard cut to a black screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio consists entirely of a solo piano performance. The piece begins with a gentle, melodic sequence at a slow-to-moderate tempo, characterized by high clarity and a bright spectral centroid. There are no vocals or background noises. (2) The player introduces more complex arpeggios and left-hand bass notes, increasing the harmonic fullness and dynamic intensity of the piano. The tonality is firmly in a major mode, evoking a sentimental and nostalgic atmosphere. (3) The music reaches a gentle climax with sustained chords and delicate high-register notes, maintaining its pristine studio quality without any incidental SFX or percussive elements. (4) The track ends as the final chord is held, slowly decaying into silence with a smooth fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a piano performance cover of 'Sudden Shower,' a song from the K-drama 'Lovely Runner.' It aims to showcase the pianist's skill while connecting with fans of the series through visual cues and drama inserts.
